title: Model magic item spell storage, slot interop and roll manipulation (M9+M10)
description: Implement families M9 (7 rows) + M10 (7 rows) from docs/audits/dnd5e-srd-5.1-final/2026-07-06-o9bd-18-7-7-3-magic-item-mechanics-inventory.md §4. M9: ring-of-spell-storing and rod-of-absorption (flagships: stored-level budgets, caster-of-record DC/ability, absorb-to-charges/slots), ioun Reserve/Absorption, pearl-of-power (slot recovery), spell-scroll casting procedure (shared with the M1 bead), candle-of-invocation free casting, staff-of-the-magi absorption with >50 overflow explosion. MUST be designed together with the Phase 1 F4 spell-slot engine (PR #406 artifact §4) — slot recovery/creation/substitution are F4 operations, not item-local state. M10: luck-blade reroll, ring-of-evasion and scarab-of-protection fail->success replacement, staff-of-charming save-flip/reflect, ring-of-spell-turning nat-20 reflect, rod-of-absorption reaction cancel, talisman-of-the-sphere PB doubling — couples to the F1 dice/roll tool surface. Recommended agent: Opus 4.8.
notes:
2026-07-08 ADR 0017 adjustment: Spell storage, slot interop, and roll manipulation should close by representing source-derived item clauses plus F1/F4/F5/F9 hook bindings. Slot counters, roll replacement execution, and overflow/absorption state are shared runtime concerns unless explicitly implemented under the engine owner.
Implemented the source-grounded family projector, strict schema validation, clause registry bindings, generated pack projection, and representative/exhaustive tests. The exact 240-row owner-tag conservation census passes; all magic items now carry reviewed executable mechanics.
close_reason: Source-faithful executable magic-item family complete; canonical regeneration, conservation gates, deep audit, and full worktree verification pass.
